summary: Regression verification of the AdMob interstitial fix (immersiveModeEnabled + expo-status-bar/expo-navigation-bar imports in /app/frontend/src/ads/interstitial.ts). On web the ads module is a no-op (adsNativeSupported=false) so showInterstitialAfterMatch() resolves false and the .finally(...) chain proceeds — verified end-to-end via Playwright at the live preview URL. App boots without crash, login works, a full offline solo match to 500 pts finished (Défaite: Nous 160 — 510 Eux in 3 hands via the new short 'Rapide' target), MatchEndOverlay renders with replay-button and back-home-button, and 'Rejouer' correctly navigates to a fresh /game/local_short_<id> URL (overlay gone, game-screen mounted). Deprecated packages / SafeAreaView / react-native issues: none introduced by this change.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/ads/interstitial.ts:20-21 ensureInterstitial() early-returns when !ADS_ENABLED || !adsNativeSupported, so on web/Expo Go no listeners are attached and the expo-status-bar/expo-navigation-bar side effects never run — the top-level imports are the only web-touching code and both packages ship a safe web shim (setStatusBarHidden is a no-op; NavigationBar.setVisibilityAsync is unreachable on web anyway). Verified at runtime: app boots and login succeeds with zero page errors.

showInterstitialAfterMatch() short-circuits to `return false` on web at line 68 BEFORE reaching interstitial.show({ immersiveModeEnabled: true }), so the new show-option addition can never affect the web match-end navigation — confirmed by 'Rejouer' successfully routing to a fresh /game/local_short_<id>.

The Platform.OS === 'ios' / 'android' guards inside OPENED/CLOSED listeners are correctly scoped so status/navigation-bar restoration cannot be triggered on web even if the ad path were reachable — safe defensively.

app/game/[id].tsx: quitAfterMatch and replay both wrap navigation in showInterstitialAfterMatch().finally(...), matching the recommended pattern; verified for replay (executed live). back-home-button uses the identical onHome=quitAfterMatch chain so behavior is the same as replay (both go through Promise.finally on the immediately-resolved no-op on web).

HandEndModal.tsx MatchEndOverlay renders replay-button + back-home-button + optional match-end-online-button — testIDs consistent with the fix scope; onlineWaiting fallback (0 for non-solo, api-driven for solo) — non-blocking here.

rca_of_issue: No bug. The AdMob 'X' clipping fix (interstitial.show({ immersiveModeEnabled: true }) + OPENED/CLOSED bar management) only executes on native Android/iOS builds where adsNativeSupported=true. On web preview it's dead code, so the fix cannot regress the web build. Full-match end -> Rejouer path, which relies on showInterstitialAfterMatch().finally(go), was exercised end-to-end and works exactly as designed.
